text:
alisha: Quick ops heads-up — we're running a set of short 'micro-calibration' sessions this week to finish final signoffs and catch regressions. Added a signup sheet: https://go.local/review-cal-ops. Please claim a 30‑min slot and indicate your timezone.

derek: 30min works. Is the plan to keep sessions focused (3 examples + 1 regression)?

sarah: Yep — 3 green / 1 regression and a 5min wrap. I'll take a 3:00–3:30pm PT slot. (Prefer afternoon PT for EU overlap).

maria: TL;DR for reviewers: bring 3 positive examples, 1 clear regression example, and any comments tied to rubric sections. We'll record consensus notes in the sheet.

derek: Who's the backup if someone no-shows?

alisha: Backup rota is on the sheet — column H. Primary backup: @jen, then pool-reviewers channel. If you swap, update the sheet and ping me.

jen: I can cover two backups on Thu/Fri 4–5pm PT. Also drop the reviewer guide link in the sheet pls.

forms-bot: Reminder: review forms will auto-lock at 2026-04-07T23:59:00Z. Make sure manager inputs are saved before lock.

alisha: Important exceptions: contractors or folks on LOA — use the exception intake form (https://go.local/review-except) and upload a CSV if bulk. CSV format:```reviewer_email,employee_email,reason``` Example row: `derek@redwood.com,contractor123@vendor.com,LOA extension`

derek: For the calibration meeting, do managers need to bring rubric score breakdowns or just the examples?

maria: Bring both. Scores help us align thresholds. Export the rubric summary from the form and paste the snippet into the meeting notes.

sarah: APAC holiday on Fri — any flexibility for those folks?

alisha: We can open a 12h exception window for APAC-only conflicts. DM me names + reason and I'll approve slot extensions.

jen: I'll pick up two APAC-friendly backup slots.

alisha: Final operational asks: 1) update the sheet when you swap, 2) export a reviewer copy before forms lock and drop in /company-drive/reviews/, 3) tag me once done. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

derek: :thumbsup:

maria: I'll attach a short manager handback checklist to the sheet in the attachments column — helps speed handoffs.

forms-bot: Confirmed: lock scheduled for 2026-04-07T23:59:00Z — last write window 48h prior.
